get.description:
Returns the entire catalog of datasets in the requested RDF serialization format. Results are paginated.

**URL:** `{ckan-host}/catalog.{format}`

Default base path (`/catalog.{format}`) can be overridden with `ckanext.dcat.catalog_endpoint` config option.

**Supported formats:** `rdf` (XML), `ttl` (Turtle), `n3`, `jsonld`, `xml`

**Content negotiation:** When `ckanext.dcat.enable_content_negotiation = True`, the catalog is also available at the root URL (`/`) via `Accept` header.

parameters.name: modified_since
parameters.description: ISO 8601 datetime — return only datasets modified after this date.

parameters.name: profiles
parameters.description: Comma-separated list of RDF profiles to use (e.g. `euro_dcat_ap_2,schemaorg`).

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Solr full-text search query to filter catalog contents.
